title: The house
intro:
A bungalow on a quiet road above the harbour, ten minutes' walk from the centre of Portree. We opened in 2018 and live here ourselves.

There are five bedrooms, each with its own shower room, a guest kitchen where the continental breakfast is laid out every morning, a lounge with a television, and a garden at the back with a barbecue. Parking is on the drive, free, and you do not need to book it.
